statement: Predictions were produced from frozen models and cutoff-audited features. No February label was used to fit, tune or select any model, and no label column is present in the sealed file.

holdout.excluded_by_design: delivery 1 Feb 2026 (decided 31 Jan, part of the January test set)

regression/linear_by_level.source: rebuilt from the unchanged Oct-Dec training rows of ml_dataset.csv (never saved originally)

classification/logistic_by_level.source: rebuilt from the unchanged Oct-Dec training rows of ml_dataset.csv (never saved originally)

classification/base_rate.source: rebuilt from the unchanged Oct-Dec training rows of ml_dataset.csv (never saved originally)

analysis_plan.eligible_observations: delivery hours with a sealed prediction from every model AND an actual value - the identical set for every model
analysis_plan.regression: MAE, RMSE, bias and sample count per model; daily MAE per model
analysis_plan.primary_comparison: random_forest vs linear_by_level: paired difference in MAE
analysis_plan.uncertainty: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap over whole days (3-day blocks primary, 1-day blocks as sensitivity), 5,000 resamples; Diebold-Mariano test with Newey-West variance, max lag 48 h
analysis_plan.interpretation_rule: a difference is called significant only if the primary 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise the comparison is reported as inconclusive
analysis_plan.classification: evaluated separately from MAE: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC (average precision), Brier score with 3-day-block intervals; precision / recall / F1 at probability 0.5; calibration in five probability bands
